notes.title: Schism 1.0!
notes.content:
It's finally here! 

It's surreal to finally be "done" with this game with how much time and energy I put into it (more than 4 years!), but at the same time it's a nice feeling to see all your hard work pay off. This was my first commercial game released, and I couldn't have hoped for a better release thanks to all the fans helping and the amazing 2 Left Thumbs for publishing and assisting with it! I've learned so much from this project that I can't wait to work on my other ideas, and I hope you look forward to them too! 

All that said, I'll still fix bugs frequently, and infrequently I'll still push big content updates! I genuinely enjoy working on this game and playing it, and have so many ideas I didn't have time to add. I'm grateful to be able to still add on to this and tweak it even after it's "finished". Expect initial bugfix updates to be between every week or month, and content updates to happen sporadically.

Thank you to everyone who helped during the making of this game! So much changed thanks to player feedback and bug hunting. This game would be a lot rougher and buggier if not for you guys.

notes.title: Schism v1.0 - Coming March 7th
notes.content:
After years of work, hundreds of items, bug fixes, and whole new mechanics added it's finally time to enter 1.0! It's hard to believe this little game I started working on in my off-time pre-covid would have so much added and so many lovely people playing it and sharing the craziness they experienced in it, but here we are! Just from memory alone, this is what's been added since it's early access release in December 2023:

[list]
[*] 2 extra final bosses with their own zones, enemies, and endings
[*] 2 secret areas with their own bosses and enemies
[*] 200+ items
[*] 40+ weapons
[*] 20+ gods, this games version of classes
[*] a bunch of weapon mods, traits weapons can randomly inherit
[*] lots of events, good and bad things that affect the player during the run
[*] Babel books, a type of item that has randomly generated effects
[*] lots of achievements
[*] memories, a set of consumables with different effects every run
[*] injoyables, a unique type of consumable with addicting properties
[*] diseases, a system of status effects that can help or hinder (usually hinder) players
[*] the ability to harm NPCs and a crime system to punish it, with it's own set of enemies
[*] meta-mods, rare mods on top of mods of weapons that make them stronger
[*] difficulty enhancers, things players can do to enhance the difficulty at their own pace
[*] enemy mods, unique enemy enhancers that give them new properties 
[*] hard-mode
[*] many crazy status effects like doom, chill, frenzy, poison, bleed, burning and more
[*] many tertiary stats like jolliness, blocking, guarding, etc.
[*] a very weird but fun tertiary stat called omen chance, which is a little poker mini-game
[*] so much more
[/list]

I was planning on 1.0 to be the previous update since the final area was added and so much was already in the game, but I felt it needed just one more patch to give it the finishing touches it deserved before sending it. There's a lot of stuff coming this update: new weapons, new items, lots of polish everywhere, lots of achievements, plenty of bugfixes, and more.

Some very silly, but strong, weapons that are being added this update include:

[list]
[*] a weapon that shoots ice storms that fire in a spinning pattern
[*] the demon core, a weapon that gives everything (you included) radiation poisoning
[*] a weapon that places mines, letting you cover rooms in explosives before battle even begins
[*] a shotgun that shoots heat-seeking missiles
[/list]

THAT SAID, this isn't the end. Bugfixes will still come regularly (between weekly to monthly), and content updates will too but at inconsistent and longer stretches of time as I take time to work on other projects and focus on myself for a bit. I love this game and could work on it forever if given the opportunity, but I have so many ideas I'd love to make a reality and so many things I need to do in my personal life, that big updates will have to wait until I find time to work on them. Expect big updates to go from once a month to every few months.

In any case, I hope you look forward to this update and the future updates of the game! Thanks for reading all this, thanks for still playing, and I hope you have fun with this update!

notes.title: Large Quality of Life Update #2
notes.content:
Hello! I've been working on improving the general feel of the game and making it more polished. Here's some of the changes!

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now leave a combat room before it starts, but you can't enter unexplored rooms this way.
[*]Many enemies now have a small visual tell to make it easier to react to their attacks.
[*]Improved weapon tooltips that show better/worse stats when comparing, and give better info at a glance
[*]Many things, like the level up menu and room reward HUD, have improved animations and sounds
[*]Lots of confusing or redundant terms/descriptions have been reworded/rephrased.
[/list]

[b]Specifics[/b]
[list]
[*] Map now has a visual indicator to show when you can teleport to a room
[*]Necessary enemies that have a frequency now have a yellow outline
[*]Level Up menu has a new animation and sounds
[*]Stats near map have an indicator when you gain/lose stats.
[*]Reward meter (top left HUD thing) now has a new animation and sounds
[*]Boss gives full reward meter on defeat
[*]Enemies now have slightly more HP.
[*]XP gain has been scaled to give you  many more levels early, and very slightly less later on
[*]Many clickable elements now have to be clicked on instead of just requiring a click anywhere
[*]Upgrading your weapon at the blacksmith now has new animations and sounds
[*]New option to scale opacity of floor for better combat clarity
[*] Tutorial now has music and many tweaks to make it more helpful
[*] Weapon tooltip shows better/weaker stats to currently equipped weapon
[*] Weapon tooltip now has name of mods under weapon name
[*]Can hold shift while scrolling over attack stat to get a breakdown of how the stat works
[*]Invincibility trap now has an effect and noticeable popup text when damaging affected enemy
[*]God Relic now has an animation
[*]Memories have better descriptions for more complex effects
[*]NPCs in treasure room to make it more apparent when you have to make a choice
[*]Explanation of second value in key/bomb hud
[*]Scrap-Bot in Weapon Room now requires you to hold Interact Key to sell item
[*]Gaining a debuff now has a more pronounced effect
[*]Popup text lasts longer and CRIT text is larger and last even longer
[*]Shop consumables now have a tooltip and short explanation
[*]Visual element in game over screen letting you know how far you got
[*]Chests now have an animation when they appear
[*]Picked up cards push out held card instead of second card
[*]Map now has visual reminder of how to open it
[*]More consistent and less redundant naming for STATS in places like Relic and Weapon descriptions
[*]Leveling Up has a new animation
[/list]
